items.title: Stock Radar: Range breakout on weekly charts helps Hindalco stock to hit record highs in April; time to buy?
items.description: Hindalco Industries Ltd has achieved a fresh record high after a 12-week consolidation, with experts suggesting a buy for short-term traders targeting Rs 1,150. The stock's strong uptrend is supported by technical indicators like the RSI and MACD, indicating continued upward momentum.
